shortDescription: LG SIGNATURE over-the-range convection microwave fits perfectly in a modern aesthetic. With remarkable speed and versatility, you can bake, roast and now even Air Fry for family-focused convenience. Spacious 1.7 cu ft interior capacity lets you cook more at the high power of 300 CFM with 2-speed ventilation for high-performance over your range. It's power, speed and function, wrapped in the modern design of LG SIGNATURE.

features.text: Crispy Flavor as Bold as Your Aesthetic

Air fry delivers crispy flavor fast with no preheating required. Just press air fry to prepare favorite snacks like french fries, hot wings and more. High temperatures and the convection fan work together to deliver the flavor and crunch you crave without the oil or the guilt.

The LG SIGNATURE over-the-range microwave elevates your culinary capabilities with built-in air sous-vide technology. This innovative feature uses precise air circulation instead of water to cook food faster, achieving a smooth and even texture while perfectly preserving the food's natural moisture and nutrients. Enjoy healthier, restaurant-quality results right in your kitchen.
LG’s convection technology means your LG microwave really can serve as a second oven. Bake or roast your favorite foods in less time.

Cleanup isn’t the most glamorous part of cooking, but wide microwave filters make it easier. They whisk away smoke and steam while cooking and feature a removable design for simple installation and removal.

Spills? Splatters? Don’t sweat it. LG’ SIGNATURE's EasyClean™ interior resists stains and buildup, so cleaning your microwave doesn’t have to be a chore. Simply wipe with a damp cloth no chemicals, no scrubbing, no problem. *Heavy build-up may require additional manual effort.
